$comment: Manual overrides on the automatic current/archived split. The automatic rule
is: the newest season the API's /seasons endpoint returns is the current one,
and every older season is archived — frozen, never fetched again, served from
whatever was cached the day it froze.
pin:     a season slug held current even after a newer season appears upstream.
Use it when next season's shell is created before this season's
playoffs have finished, which would otherwise freeze results early.
Remember to clear it, or the league stops updating.
archive: season slugs frozen early, before a successor exists.
Slugs are <year>-<season name>, e.g. 2026-fall. An unknown slug in either
field is warned about and ignored rather than being fatal.
